verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents its own case-management queue: screening and monitoring alerts can be prioritised, filtered, assigned and reviewed. Reviewers record case decisions such as 'no risk detected' or 'risk detected- offboard', and a case audit trail is kept. The documented scope is screening-alert review, not identity verification, so there is no evidence the queue carries document images or extracted document fields. missing for 10: document images in the review queue, extracted identity-document fields, explicit routing of borderline identity verifications, documentation that decisions update the customer record, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, borderline verifications land in a manual review queue with the full evidence — document images, extracted fields, check results — and reviewer decisions feed back into the record

citations.quote: Its case management solution allows you to prioritise and review risk alerts raised during onboarding and ongoing monitoring.
Filter cases by customer risk, case stage, who the case is assigned to, or when it was created.
They can then select a case decision of ‘no risk detected’, ‘risk detected- accepted’ and ‘risk detected- offboard’.
high-risk or complex cases are automatically escalated for human expert review.
Returns the audit log trail for a case.
